sections.text: Master the market. On your terms. Kojoforex Academy. World-class trading education engineered for every stage of your evolution. Accessible globally, perfected locally. View Curriculum PHYSICAL • ONLINE

90 DAYS 01 / 06 Physical & Online Venues Join us at our state-of-the-art campus in Accra, Ghana, or access the exact same elite curriculum globally online. 02 / 06 Live Market Processing Trade live alongside professionals, breaking down real-time active market structures. 03 / 06 Intimate Cohorts Limited class sizes guaranteeing individualized portfolio and risk audits. 04 / 06 3-Month Sprint A robust timeline designed to take you from fundamentals to advanced modeling. 05 / 06 Architectural Fra…

THE VENUES Two platforms. One standard. Whether you prefer the immersion of a physical classroom or the flexibility of borderless access, the curriculum remains uncompromising. Physical. Immersive, in-person training. Surround yourself with driven peers and get hands-on, over-the-shoulder guidance in a state-of-the-art facility. Online. Borderless education. Access the exact same elite curriculum, live sessions, and mentorship from anywhere in the world, entirely on your schedule.
